title: Kissed Fluffy Ethiopian Coconut Onigiri
description: A sour, fluffy, and festive Ethiopian dish featuring coconut cream and nigiri-shaping, perfect for those with onion and garlic sensitivities.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine teff flour, salt, and active dry yeast.
Gradually add in water and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Add in sour injera starter and mix well.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat a non-stick skillet or injera pan over medium heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the dough into small balls and flatten them slightly into disks.
Cook the disks for 1-2 minutes on each side, until they are lightly browned and crispy.
In a small bowl, mix together coconut cream, unsweetened shredded coconut, and lemon juice.
Brush the coconut mixture onto the cooked disks and shape them into triangular onigiri shapes.
